items.basis: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION mix (per kg charged, as China file): 45% pig iron (1.859) + 30% steel scrap (1.204) + 25% returns valued at the charge's own cost -> metallics = (0.45x1.859 + 0.30x1.204)/0.75 = 1.597; + FeSiMg 1.3% x 5.511 (FeSi75 PROXY) = 0.072; + inoculant 0.4% x 5.511 = 0.022; / 0.98 melt & treatment loss = 1.725 PLN/kg.
items.notes: Floor: pig is merchant not nodular grade, FeSiMg priced at FeSi, excludes carburiser, Cu/Sn pearlite additions, CBAM on pig, freight and the clean-scrap premium.

items.basis: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION mix (induction grey iron, as China file): 25% pig (1.859) + 40% steel scrap (1.204) + 35% returns at charge cost -> (0.25x1.859 + 0.40x1.204)/0.65 = 1.456; + FeSi75 0.7% (Si trim + inoculant) x 5.511 = 0.039; / 0.98 = 1.525 PLN/kg.
